script.title: देव दीपावली के दस लाख दीयों की शुरुआत 1991 में हुई
sentences: एक रात, गंगा किनारे दस लाख से ज़्यादा दीये।
कार्तिक पूर्णिमा पर, दिवाली के पंद्रह दिन बाद, बनारस देव दीपावली मनाता है।
रविदास घाट से राजघाट तक, हर घाट की सीढ़ियाँ दीयों से भर जाती हैं।
मान्यता है कि इस दिन देवता धरती पर उतरकर गंगा में स्नान करते हैं।
इक्कीस युवा पुजारी और चौबीस युवतियाँ गंगा आरती करते हैं।
ये नज़ारा देखकर लगता है, परंपरा सदियों पुरानी होगी।
पर घाटों पर दीये जलाने की ये रीत 1991 में दशाश्वमेध घाट से शुरू हुई।
शुरू की थी पंडित किशोरी रमण दुबे, यानी बाबू महाराज ने।
मतलब देवताओं की ये दिवाली, उम्र में शायद आपसे छोटी है।
scenes: Extreme close-up of a young Varanasi woman's face lit by a clay diya held in her palms, eyes glowing with wonder, a million lamps blurred on the ghat steps behind her, night.
The Varanasi ghats on Kartik Purnima night with endless rows of clay lamps on every step, boats on the Ganga, full moon rising, wide panoramic shot.
Devotees lighting clay lamps step after step on the Varanasi ghats from end to end, flames reflecting in the Ganga, warm night glow, long wide shot.
Radiant divine figures descending from a starry sky toward the glowing Ganga at Varanasi, soft celestial light, lamps on the ghats below, dreamy wide shot.
Young priests in saffron and white raising tall brass aarti lamps in unison on the Dashashwamedh Ghat, young women in saris beside them, smoke and flames, night, medium wide shot.
An old boatman in Varanasi gazing at the glowing ghats with awe, rowing slowly, lamps reflecting on the water around his wooden boat, night, medium shot.
In 1991, a small group of Varanasi locals in simple kurtas lighting the first few clay lamps on the steps of Dashashwamedh Ghat, hopeful faces, quiet night, medium shot.
An elderly Varanasi priest in a white dhoti and shawl, seen from behind, placing a single lit diya on the ghat step, the Ganga dark beyond, warm intimate light, medium shot.
A child on the Varanasi ghats placing a floating lamp on the Ganga during Dev Deepawali, smiling, countless lamps behind, magical night glow, medium close-up.
script.description:
कार्तिक पूर्णिमा पर बनारस के घाट दस लाख से ज़्यादा दीयों से जगमगाते हैं।
पर दीये जलाने की ये परंपरा शुरू कब हुई?
claims_en: On Dev Deepawali more than a million earthen lamps light the ghats of the Ganges in Varanasi.
Dev Deepawali falls on Kartik Purnima, fifteen days after Diwali, in Varanasi.
The steps of all the ghats from Ravidas Ghat to Rajghat are lit with lamps.
Mythologically, the gods are believed to descend to Earth to bathe in the Ganges on this day (framed as belief).
The aarti is performed by 21 young Brahmin priests and 24 young women.
The tradition of lighting the lamps on Dev Deepawali was first started at Dashashwamedh Ghat in 1991.
It was started by Pandit Kishori Raman Dubey (Babu Maharaj).
